children: RNS Number : 8607X  AO World plc  06 October 2026
Director / PDMR Shareholding - Sale of Shares
AO World PLC announces that, on 5 October 2026, John Roberts (Chief Executive Officer of the Company) sold 3,618,075 ordinary shares of 0.25p each ("Ordinary Shares") at a price of £0.83p per share.
As a result of the transaction, John Roberts holds 79,608,757* Ordinary Shares representing 14.08% of the current issued share capital of the Company.

*The beneficial holding for John Roberts excludes 6,348 Ordinary Shares held by Crystalcraft Limited, a company of which he is a director and shareholder and 2,325,879 Ordinary Shares held by the Jolly Foundation, of which he is a trustee, member and director.
